decisions.title: Use STRICT governance and GitHub Actions acceptance
decisions.decision: Use STRICT Skill Workflow governance and GitHub Actions as the sole project acceptance authority.
decisions.rationale: The system is network-facing infrastructure with evidence lineage, untrusted input, cross-platform requirements, and multi-session development.

decisions.title: Native core portability with containerized service boundaries
decisions.decision: Test the Python core natively on Linux, Windows, and macOS; isolate service-heavy dependencies behind contracts and Linux containers.
decisions.rationale: This proves application portability without making false claims that every external service runs identically and natively on every operating system.

decisions.title: Hard-cap search calls at two per grounding request
decisions.decision: The core grounding budget rejects requests above two search-provider calls and never silently expands the budget.
decisions.rationale: Bounded retrieval cost and predictable provider usage are product requirements; later query decomposition may parallelize candidates inside a round but may not exceed the request-level search-call cap.
